name: ffmpeg-player-napi-prototype
description: Node.js N-API prototype for ffmpeg player core

scripts.build:cmake: cmake -B build-cmake -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake -E copy_if_different build-cmake/compile_commands.json compile_commands.json && cmake --build build-cmake --config Release
scripts.ide:compile-commands: cmake -B build-cmake -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake -E copy_if_different build-cmake/compile_commands.json compile_commands.json
scripts.clean:cmake: cmake -E rm -rf build-cmake && cmake -E rm -f compile_commands.json
